description.value: A McDonald's Canada fast-food outlet located in North Vancouver, serving burgers, chicken, breakfast, and McCafé beverages. The location includes a drive-through and offers takeaway. As a large chain presence on a cycling route, it could serve as a calorie stop, though the site is primarily designed around vehicle access.
